name: The Amaranth
source:
Play as the Caitiff, a serial masquerade offender that has bitten off more than they can chew. Now the target of a Blood Hunt sanctioned by the Camarilla, salvation comes in the form of The Toreador, who promises to fix all their problems for a small price. Five nights ago, the Toreador received an amaranth; the symbol of an upcoming diablerie.  If the Caitiff can discover the traitor’s identity, they are promised safety from the Masquerade’s consequence...and they might even find their true clan.

[From [url=https://noblemermaidia.itch.io/the-amaranth]Itch.io[/url]]
